info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Marketing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Prospect Campaign Management API enables businesses to modify marketing campaign parameters dynamically. With the PATCH method, users can update specific aspects of ongoing marketing campaigns identified by a unique parameter. This API is particularly useful for marketing teams looking to optimize their campaigns in real-time, allowing them to adjust strategies based on performance metrics or target audience changes. Typical consumers of this API include marketing analysts and campaign managers who require swift adaptability to market conditions.

patch.summary: Update a prospect campaign management entry.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the information related to a specific prospect campaign management entry identified by its unique ID. Ensure to provide the necessary fields that need to be updated in the request.

requestBody.description: Updates the prospect campaign management details for the specified resource. This request body should contain the necessary fields that need to be changed or updated in the campaign. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the expected schema to avoid validation errors.
